pull.title: Publish Develocity Build Scans for the Docker images
pull.body:
Publishes a Develocity Build Scan for each image the `docker_build_and_test` and `docker_official_image_build_and_test` workflows build. A new `Setup Docker` step runs the Develocity Docker build agent beside the build, using the `setup-docker` action from `gradle/develocity-actions`. The agent captures what reaches BuildKit, so the Dockerfiles and the build commands stay as they are.

The scans go to develocity.apache.org under the `kafka` project, with the `DEVELOCITY_ACCESS_KEY` secret the Gradle builds already use. The build scripts pass `--build-arg DEVELOCITY_PROJECT_ID=kafka`, which names the scans. They build from a copy of the context outside the git work tree, so without it a scan has no project name.

Documentation for the action: https://github.com/gradle/develocity-actions#setup-docker-action

✅ [Done](https://github.com/apache/infrastructure-actions/pull/1364): Note, that the`gradle/develocity-actions/setup-docker` is not on the ASF actions allowlist yet. It needs to be added to https://github.com/apache/infrastructure-actions before these workflows can run it.

Reviewers: Clay Johnson <cjohnson@gradle.com>

issue.title: Add gradle/develocity-actions/setup-docker to allow list
issue.body:
## Overview

`setup-docker` starts the Develocity Docker agent, which captures `docker buildx` builds run later in the job and publishes them as [Develocity Build Scans](https://docs.develocity.ai/docker/0.9/getting-started/#build-scan). It is the Docker counterpart of `gradle/develocity-actions/setup-maven`, already on the allow list.

Requested by:
- Apache NiFi: apache/nifi#11759 ([NIFI-16426](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/NIFI-16426)), closed pending this allow-list entry ([comment](https://github.com/apache/nifi/pull/11759#issuecomment-5994907351))
- Apache Kafka: apache/kafka#23711

**Name of action:** gradle/develocity-actions/setup-docker

**URL of action:** https://github.com/gradle/develocity-actions/tree/main/setup-docker

**Version to pin to ([hash only](https://infra.apache.org/github-actions-policy.html)):** `f852d93dada312948b1ba533226c28e05d756866` (v2.4)

## Permissions

- No GitHub token is used. Outputs are a job summary only.
- Takes the Develocity access key as an input. It is exchanged for a short-lived token, and both are masked with `core.setSecret`.
- Downloads the agent jar from `https://develocity-docker-build-agent.gradle.com`, or from an override URL if one is configured. If the runner has no JDK 21+, it downloads one from `api.adoptium.net`.
- Attaches to the current buildx builder, or the one named in `buildx-builder`, to observe builds.

## Related Actions

`gradle/develocity-actions/setup-maven` and `maven-publish-build-scan` are already allowed, and come from the same repository and release process. No allowed action captures Docker builds.

## Checklist

- [ ] The action is listed in the GitHub Actions Marketplace
- [x] The action is not already on the list of approved actions
- [x] The action has a sufficient number of contributors or has contributors within the ASF community
- [x] The action has a clearly defined license
- [x] The action is actively developed or maintained
- [x] The action has CI/unit tests configured
- [x] Compiled JavaScript in `dist/` matches a clean rebuild (verify with `uv run utils/verify-action-build.py org/repo@hash`)

---
Drafted-by: Claude Code (Opus 5.5) (reviewed by @jprinet before posting)
